about.description: For each name our towns go by (catalogues/codes/places.json: the town's own and those known in visitors' languages), the biggest town outside the site's countries that has it among its names (Latin ones, any language), as [country, population], from GeoNames' cities1000 (https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/, CC BY 4.0). The builder reads a place that names only its town as ours when ours is the bigger by far. Built by builder/tools/places.mjs.
